assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL production 2D game sprite atlas of buried industrial-city relics for the underground cross-section of Rainbow Patrol's stormy mountain-city mission. Style reference: this project's own supplied world-details sheet; match its warm richly painted Amiga adventure illustration quality, but create DIFFERENT non-dinosaur objects. Genuine transparent PNG1536x1024, EXACTLY FOUR columns TWO rows, each cell384x512. Eight isolated side-view shallow underground discoveries, common ground baseline y420 relative to each row, each fits cell x22..362,y150..438, clear transparent gutters. Reading order: (1) broken redbrick Victorian drainage arch and old pipe; (2) half-buried rusted steam railway wheel with short broken rail; (3) shattered workshop gears and small anvil among brick fragments; (4) broken old wooden biplane wing ribs, torn fabric and a cracked propeller hub; (5) riveted iron water pipe elbow and weathered valve wheel; (6) low ruined cellar arch with dusty bottles and crockery; (7) bent old bridge girder and masonry blocks; (8) abandoned timber supply crates, a battered metal can and a coil of old cable. Weathered ochre earth clumps and dark grey small stones partly cling to each discovery, but no complete landscape or broad base plate. All are compact horizontal side-view sprite clusters meant to be embedded below terrain, no floating pieces. Restrained rusty brown, desaturated blue-grey, old timber, red brick, muted brass; no bright flags. No dinosaurs, skeletons, mummies, people, letters, writing, label, panels, outlines, grid or backdrop. Preserve true transparent alpha; do not paint checkerboard. Same original game-art style as reference, no commercial assets.
